$sources: ACI 318-19 Sec 22.5.3.1 (sqrt f'c in shear) and AISC 360-22 Sec B4.2 (ERW wall thickness); the stair geometry rules are the extended pack's until the IBC 2021 Sec 1011 rules are in the pack (see VERIFY.md)
source: ACI 318-19 and AISC 360-22: the cap of sqrt f'c in shear and torsion and the ERW design wall thickness factor (the same values as the extended pack); the stair geometry rules are inherited.

sources.shearRootFcMax: ACI 318-19 Sec 22.5.3.1: sqrt f'c used to calculate Vc at most 100 psi (8.3 MPa), unless the minimum shear reinforcement is provided
sources.erwWallFactor: AISC 360-22 Sec B4.2: design wall thickness 0.93 times the nominal wall thickness of electric-resistance-welded (ERW) HSS
